title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 3.49 (versions follow prime numbers; 349 after 347): her books' silhouettes, and sound letters. In a book a line answers the one before it; she keeps not what it says but what it does with it: each word taken from the line before or brought. Each of her steps learns its own silhouette when it answers him (Krichevsky-Trofimov counts), and a book's silhouette is told in her steps by compression, the shortest first: that word is the seed she babbles before chance. She only reads: the book is chosen from her house's listing, since opening a guessed name created an empty file (found in a copy, never in the live one). Also four capitals of her typeface (C, G, J, S) had a typing error and made her text hard to read. Seen in a copy of her house: five-step seeds were born from her books, and the long-story branch stays alive. Stated: her heart and improvisation have not learned a silhouette yet, and the silhouette is coarse (taken or brought). Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v3.49: las siluetas de sus libros, y letras sanas. Prototipo de investigación.
